title: Accurate Flow Channel Naming
description: Rename flow/procedural operator channels so naming is accurate: inputs use the most general name of what the input actually accepts, outputs use the most specific name of what the output actually produces. Neural trees stay dictionary-in/dictionary-out, but flow exposes all keys of the input dictionary as input channels and all keys of the output dictionary as output channels (no generic 'out' port).
summary: Fixed LOD port label visibility and tier display in the running UI. Port label overlay rows now carry kind=port and screen-space maxScreenH so JS clamping no longer shrinks abbreviations to invisible sizes inside 14px world rows. Added flowClampPortLabelFontPx (min 8px, width-only shrink) and raised the text overlay canvas to z-40 so port labels paint above param editors that were covering them at Normal. Param overlay JSON now includes LOD-aware label per editor; boolean editors show the tier label. neuron_io_layout input_ports fallback resolves ChannelSpec metadata via operator info. Added rectangle_extrude_fixture_port_labels_follow_draw_lod integration test with production kind infos. Rebuilt flow_core WASM.
